# Dictum — Prep Notes

## Source Mapping
- **ColorLib slug:** consula
- **Preview URL:** https://preview.colorlib.com/theme/consula/
- **New name:** dictum
- **Screenshot URL:** https://colorlib.com/wp/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/consula-free-template.jpg

## Section Order (from preview DOM)

1. **Top Bar** — Light gray bg, social icons (FB, Twitter, IG, LinkedIn) left, phone + email right
2. **Navbar** — White bg, sticky, logo "Dictum." left, nav links right (Home, About Us, Team, Services, Testimonials, Blog, Contact)
3. **Hero** — Full-width bg image with overlay, "We Are The Best Consulting Agency" heading, "Get Started" CTA
4. **About Us** — Split: left image with "50 years" badge, right text "Welcome To Dictum" + description
5. **Team** — 3 cards: circular avatar + name + role (3 members)
6. **How It Works** — 3 steps: Innovate, Create, Scale with descriptions
7. **Services** — 6 cards in 3-col grid: Business Consulting, Market Analysis, User Monitoring, Insurance Consulting, Financial Investment, Financial Management
8. **Testimonials** — Centered carousel with circular avatar + quote + author
9. **Blog** — 3 post previews with titles
10. **Contact** — Left sidebar (Services list), right form (fname, lname, email, subject, message + submit)
11. **CTA Banner** — Full-width teal (#46ddb0) bg, "Let's Get Started" white heading
12. **Footer** — Dark (#333) bg, 4 cols: About Us, Quick Links, Follow Us, Subscribe Newsletter

## Fidelity Notes

### Top Bar
- Light gray (#f8f9fa) background
- Social icons on left: Facebook, Twitter, Instagram, LinkedIn
- Contact info on right: phone (+1 234 5678 9101), email (info@yourdomain.com)
- Use lucide-react icons for social media

### Navbar
- White background, sticky on scroll
- Logo: bold black text "Dictum" + teal (#46ddb0) dot
- Nav links: Home, About Us, Team, Services, Testimonials, Blog, Contact
- Active link highlighted in teal
- Mobile: hamburger menu toggle

### Hero
- Background image with dark overlay (use picsum.photos)
- Large white heading "We Are The Best Consulting Agency"
- Descriptive lorem ipsum paragraph
- "Get Started" button: teal bg (#46ddb0), white text, border-radius 30px

### About Us
- Split layout: left image with experience badge, right text
- Experience badge: "50 years of experience" overlay on image
- Section sub-title "About Us" in teal (13px)
- Heading "Welcome To Dictum" in black
- Description paragraph

### Team
- 3-column grid of team member cards
- Each: circular avatar (border-radius 50%), name (h3), role
- Use picsum.photos for avatar images

### How It Works
- 3-column layout
- Each step: heading (Innovate, Create, Scale) + description
- Clean white background

### Services
- 3-column grid, 6 cards total
- Each card: lucide-react icon + title + description
- Services: Business Consulting, Market Analysis, User Monitoring, Insurance Consulting, Financial Investment, Financial Management
- Light gray bg (#f8f9fa)

### Testimonials
- Centered, max-width 800px
- Carousel/slider of testimonials
- Each: circular avatar, italic blockquote, author name
- Use picsum.photos for avatars

### Blog
- 3-column grid
- Each post: date badge, title (h2 with link), brief text
- Clean white background

### Contact
- Split: left sidebar "Our Services" list, right contact form
- Form fields: First Name, Last Name, Email, Subject, Message (textarea)
- Rounded inputs (border-radius 30px)
- Teal focus border color

### CTA Banner
- Full-width teal (#46ddb0) background
- White heading "Let's Get Started"
- Centered text

### Footer
- Dark (#333333) background
- 4 columns: About Us (description), Quick Links (list), Follow Us (social icons), Subscribe Newsletter (email input + button)
- Copyright line with Component Dock link
